name: devsync
description: Write code on this machine, run it on a remote one. A Source Control–style panel for syncing and running commands remotely, built for flaky connections.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with devsync
walkthroughs.description: Edit here, run on a remote machine — even over a bad connection.

steps.title: Install the devsync command
steps.description:
The extension uses the `devsync` command-line tool. Install it once, then check it works.
[Run Doctor](command:devsync.doctor)

steps.title: Connect your project
steps.description:
Tell devsync where the code should run: `user@host:path`.
[Connect Project to Remote](command:devsync.init)

steps.title: Meet the devsync panel
steps.description:
It lives in Source Control, next to Git: files not yet on the remote, conflicts, and your remote jobs.
[Show Panel](command:devsync.showPanel)

steps.title: Run your first command
steps.description:
Type a command in the devsync box and press ⌘Enter / Ctrl+Enter. It syncs, runs on the remote, and shows the output.
[Run Command on Remote](command:devsync.run)

steps.title: Long jobs and results
steps.description:
Training runs and servers keep going even if the connection drops.
[Run in Background](command:devsync.runBackground)

steps.title: Let Claude Code use the remote
steps.description:
Claude Code's tests, builds and installs run on the remote automatically.
[Set Up Claude Code](command:devsync.setupClaude)

devsync.binaryPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `devsync` binary. Empty: look it up on `PATH` (and `~/.local/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin`).

devsync.autoSync.description: Send every save to the remote automatically (devsync watch) when a devsync project is opened. Pausing or resuming auto sync from the UI is remembered per project and takes precedence.

devsync.openOutputOnBackgroundRun.description: Open a background job's output when it starts.

devsync.sourceControl.description: Also show devsync in the Source Control view (next to Git). The devsync sidebar in the Activity Bar is always available. Takes effect after reloading the window.

devsync.git.enabled.description: Show the remote project's git repository in Source Control as "Git (remote)": stage, commit, push, pull and branch on the remote, with diffs.

devsync.git.smartCommit.description: Commit all changes on the remote when nothing is staged, without asking.

devsync.git.blame.description: Show who last changed the current line (remote git blame) in the status bar.

devsync.git.autofetch.description: Periodically run git fetch on the remote repository.
